chunks.text: Her Career Conference 2026 — Her Future of Work (2nd Edition). Presented by Intelligent Nest and MamaNest. Main event: May 30, 2026, 1:30 PM to 5:00 PM at District 3 Innovation Centre, 1250 Rue Guy Suite #600, Montreal, QC H3H 2L3. Workshop series: June 1-5, 2026, online. Registration: https://luma.com/qxt3t6an. Hashtag: #HerFutureOfWork. Nesta launches live at the conference on May 30.

Session 1: Welcome and Opening. Speaker: Mahsa Rezaei. May 30, 1:30-2:00 PM. 30 minutes. District3. Opening ceremony, introduction to the conference theme Her Future of Work, and launch of the day's program.
Session 2: Opening Keynote. Speaker: Lianna Della Vecchia. May 30, 2:00-2:15 PM. 15 minutes. District3. Opening keynote address setting the tone for the conference.
Session 3: Closing Keynote. Speaker: Mahsa Rezaei. May 30, 2:15-2:45 PM. 30 minutes. District3. Keynote presentation by Mahsa Rezaei on the future of work and the Intelligent Nest vision.

Session 4: Speed Networking. Facilitator: Jeffrey To. May 30, 2:45-3:15 PM. 30 minutes. District3. Interactive speed networking session facilitated by Jeffrey To, a psychology PhD candidate and public speaking coach for tech professionals.
Session 5: Break. May 30, 3:15-3:30 PM. 15 minutes. No speaker. Attendees free to network, use Nesta, or visit sponsor tables.

Session 6: Panel — Women, Work & What's Next: Navigating the Future of Work. Panelists: Lin Sok, Dominique Pirolo, Samantha Bateman, Rachel Beyerlein. May 30, 3:30-4:30 PM. 60 minutes. District3. The panel explores what is changing in hiring and workplace systems, how AI reshapes opportunity and bias, what women need to stay ahead, and how to navigate the future of work.
Session 7: Closing Keynote. Speaker: Stefania Pecore. May 30, 4:30-4:50 PM. 20 minutes. District3. Closing keynote by Stefania Pecore, Executive Director of Women Techmakers Montreal.
Session 8: Closing Remarks and Award. May 30, 4:50-5:00 PM. 10 minutes. District3. Final closing remarks, award ceremony, and celebration of the day.

Workshop 1: AI-Ready for Your Career — Turning Fear into Opportunity. Speaker: Prisca Onyebuchi. June 1, 2026, 12:00-1:00 PM. Online. Helps women overcome fear of AI and discover how to use it as a career opportunity.
Workshop 2: From AI-Assisted to AI-Native — Career Strategy. Speaker: Farshad Rouhani. June 2, 2026, 4:00-5:00 PM. Online. Coaches through the shift from AI-assisted work to AI-native organizations.
Workshop 3: The Experimentation Habit — The Skill That Future-Proofs You. Speaker: Ysimer (Ysi) Gonzalez. June 3, 2026, 4:00-5:00 PM. Online. Process before tools, always.
Workshop 4: Agility and AI Literacy — A Non-Linear Learning Path. Speaker: Marie-Claire Asseko. June 4, 2026, 4:00-5:00 PM. Online. Relevant for immigrant women and underrepresented communities.

Workshop 5: From Employee to Architect — Portfolio Career in the Age of AI. Speaker: Natalie Loop. June 5, 2026, 4:00-5:00 PM. Online. Relevant for women considering portfolio careers and self-employment.
